items.quote: Our Instagram ads finally reach people near the store, and enquiries now come straight into WhatsApp. We reply from one place instead of juggling DMs, calls and forms.

items.photoAlt: Founder of a grocery delivery startup in their warehouse
items.quote: Our Android and iOS apps went live together, and updates still keep coming.
Design, app, software and marketing — all handled by one team with one invoice.

items.photoAlt: Furniture showroom owner holding a tablet with a 3D floor plan
items.quote: The 3D views let us walk the showroom before a single partition went up.

We came for floor plans and stayed for everything else. The same team drew our villas in 2D and 3D, prepared the BOQ, built the booking app and ran the launch campaign. One WhatsApp group replaced four vendors and endless follow-ups.
Patients book appointments in the app and get WhatsApp reminders. The team tested it on every phone our patients use before launch.
Billing, stock and staff logins run on one system now — no more end-of-day spreadsheets.
We chose the subscription model because our processes keep changing. Every new requirement gets added without a new contract, and the security checks run in the background.
They turn our sketches into accurate CAD drawings quickly, and the bill of quantities matches the drawings line for line, which makes contractor quotes far easier.

items.question: Can I hire you for just one service?
items.answer: Yes. Each service is available on its own. Many clients start with one and add others as they grow.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside India?
items.answer: Yes. We work with clients across India and abroad, with meetings and delivery handled remotely.

items.question: Subscription or one-time software: which suits me?
items.answer: Subscription suits software whose requirements keep evolving and need ongoing support. One-time purchase suits fixed operational needs where you want complete ownership. We recommend one after understanding your requirements.

items.question: How long does a mobile app take to build?
items.answer: It depends on scope: features, platforms and integrations. After a discovery call we share a timeline for your specific app.

items.question: What does a CAD project include?
items.answer: Accurate 2D and 3D drawings, smart space planning and a bill of quantities (BOQ), for residential, retail, commercial and industrial projects.

items.question: Which marketing channels do you manage?
items.answer: SEO, Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads, YouTube, email and WhatsApp marketing.

items.question: How do you keep my data secure?
items.answer: Security is built into every layer: data protection, network security, threat detection and prevention, and compliance and risk management.

We chose the subscription model because our processes keep changing. Every new requirement gets added without a new contract, and the security checks run in the background.
They turn our sketches into accurate CAD drawings quickly, and the bill of quantities matches the drawings line for line, which makes contractor quotes far easier.
